CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Wednesday, October 25, 2023
PLANNING COMMISSION MINUTES  Regular Meeting, 6:00 PM

Axzel Roman, Vice Chairmember  Fabiola Hernandez, Commissioner
Ana Rodriguez, Commissioner  Luis Gonzalez, Commissioner

  Grant Winford,
  Chairmember

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Planning Commission meeting was called to order on Wednesday, October 25,
2023 at 6:00 PM.

FLAG SALUTE

The flag salute was led by Commissioner Gonzalez.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Chairmember Winford
  Vice Chairmember Roman
  Commissioner Gonzalez
  Commissioner Hernandez
  Commissioner Rodriguez
ABSENT
  None
Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced a quorum.

PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

REGULAR MEETING
OCTOBER 25, 2023 Page 1
 Commissioner Rodriguez spoke.

Patrick Donegan, Assistant City Attorney, spoke.

Chair Winford spoke.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the floor for nominations for Chair.

Vice Chair Roman nominated himself for Chair.

Commissioner Rodriguez nominated Chair Winford for Chair.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed the nominations for Chair.

A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Roman, to nominate himself for Chair of the
Planning Commission, effective January 1, 2024.

The motion Carried by the following vote:

AYES: 3; Winford, Roman, Gonzalez
NOES: 2; Hernandez, Rodriguez
ABSENT: 0;
RECUSE: 0;

Motion Carried: 3–2–0–0

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, opened the floor for nominations for Vice Chair.

Vice Chair Roman nominated Chair Winford for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Gonzalez nominated Commissioner Rodriguez for Vice Chair.

Commissioner Rodriguez nominated Commissioner Hernandez for Vice Chair.

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, closed the nominations for Vice Chair.

A motion was made by Vice Chairmember Roman, to nominate Chair Winford for Vice
Chairmember of the Planning Commission, effective January 1, 2024.

The motion Failed by the following vote:

AYES: 1; Roman
NOES: 4; Winford, Gonzalez, Hernandez, Rodriguez
ABSENT: 0;
RECUSE: 0;

Motion Failed: 1–4–0–0

 B.  CONSENT CALENDAR

 1.
  WAIVE READING IN FULL OF ALL ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS ON
  THE AGENDA

  That the Planning Commission waive reading in full of all ordinances and
  resolutions on the agenda and declare that said titles which appear on the public
  agenda shall be determined to have been read by title and further reading

  SUGGESTED ACTION: Approve Recommendation.
